subject: Run Medford Event and Athletic Legacy
overview: Race director Dave McGillivray discussed the history of his 1978 cross-country run and the upcoming Run Medford event scheduled for September 2025. He shared his philosophy on using athletics to build self-esteem and recounted his transition from a local Medford business owner to a global event manager.

items.title: Guest Introduction
items.summary: Dave McGillivray introduced himself as the president of DMSE Sports and the longtime race director of the Boston Marathon.

items.title: Run Medford and 1978 Cross-Country Run
items.summary: McGillivray described his 1978 run from Oregon to Massachusetts to benefit the Jimmy Fund and how it inspired the current Run Medford event.

items.title: Professional Event Management History
items.summary: The discussion covered McGillivray's career path from opening a running store in Haines Square to directing over 1,400 athletic events worldwide.

items.title: 2025 Run Medford Schedule
items.summary: The fourth annual event is scheduled for September 26-27, featuring track events at the stadium and road races starting at City Hall to benefit local school PTOs.

items.title: Personal Philosophy and Resilience
items.summary: McGillivray spoke about the role of running in building self-confidence, specifically reflecting on being the last pick for sports during his childhood in Medford.

items.title: Career Highlights and Boston Marathon
items.summary: The guest highlighted his 38-year tenure with the Boston Marathon and his experience directing a marathon held entirely inside Fenway Park.

items.title: Cross-Country Run Logistics
items.summary: McGillivray explained the support strategies used during his 80-day run, including breaking the distance into 10-mile segments and rotating through eight pairs of shoes.
